description: Runs the TypeScript compiler and returns structured diagnostics (file, line, column, code, message). Note: In compact mode, diagnostics are trimmed to file, line, and code — column and message fields are omitted to save tokens.

declarationDir.description: Output directory for .d.ts declaration files (maps to --declarationDir). Use with --declaration.

emitDeclarationOnly.description: Only emit .d.ts declaration files without JS output (maps to --emitDeclarationOnly)

incremental.description: Enable incremental compilation for faster repeated checks (maps to --incremental)

listEmittedFiles.description: List emitted output files when emit is enabled (maps to --listEmittedFiles). Default: true when noEmit=false.

pretty.description: Enable or disable pretty-printed output (maps to --pretty). Set false for normalized parser-friendly output.

skipLibCheck.description: Skip type checking of declaration files for faster feedback (maps to --skipLibCheck)

name: tsc
title: TypeScript Check
